emma: Quick sync — SFO3 region rollout: need owners for routing policy + data residency for EU customers that may fallback to SFO3. Who owns egress peering and KMS config? We need to unblock dedicated cutover by EOW.
raj: I can take egress peering + route policies. Will validate BGP ASNs and announce plan. @maria can you confirm KMS availability in SFO3 or suggested pattern for EU-residency?
maria: SFO3 doesn't have customer-managed KMS in-region for EU-residency. We can provision a regional key in SFO3, but that won't meet EU-key residency. Suggest short-term: envelope key in SFO and master key in AMS (if security approves). cc @chris
chris: We can't keep EU customer key material outside EU for residency guarantees. No cross-region master replication allowed per policy. Security will need a design: either provision an AMS KMS and route keys, or block EU-residency customers from SFO3. I'll draft options.
leo: Infra update: firewall rules and peering prep mostly done. PR 4321 contains ingress/egress ACLs and BGP config snippets. Needs review before we flip.
julie: I'll review PR 4321 this afternoon. Canary ask: who will own canary traffic control? We should schedule a small burst test Friday morning.
emma: I'll own canary routing. Proposed plan: 1% production traffic -> SFO3 for 2 hours, monitor latency/errors, rollback if SLOs breach. I'll add to runbook.
oncall-bot: AUTO: deploy succeeded to sfo3-stage at 2026-03-17T08:45Z (build 2026.317.3)
raj: Dependencies checklist: DNS TTL change (low TTL window), CDN config for origin selection, model routing policy to prefer eu-region for EU customers, and KG/Key approval from security. @leo can you confirm the TTL change window and who will update DNS?
leo: I'll set TTL to 60s for the cutover window and open infra-ticket INFRA-2981 to track. Will coordinate with dns-ops for propagation.
maria: Security action items: (1) I'll draft KMS options doc by EOD with recommended approach for EU keys + SFO fallback, (2) identify any HSM/KMS procurement needs. @chris to review.
emma: Action summary: (A) @raj owns peering + routing PR updates, (B) @maria + @chris own KMS/design, (C) @leo owns TTL/infra-ticket, (D) @julie reviews PR + schedules canary, (E) @emma will update cutover checklist and runbook. Will reconvene if blockers; otherwise async updates here. :thumbsup:
